lines.en: Who is the student's best critic?
lines.zh: 谁是学生最好的评论家？

lines.en: I am an art student and I paint a lot of pictures.
lines.zh: 我是一名艺术生，画了很多画。

lines.en: Many people pretend that they understand modern art.
lines.zh: 许多人假装他们懂现代艺术。

lines.en: They always tell you what a picture is 'about'.
lines.zh: 他们总是告诉你一幅画是“关于”什么的。

lines.en: Of course, many pictures are not 'about' anything.
lines.zh: 当然，许多画根本就不是“关于”什么的。

lines.en: We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material.
lines.zh: 我们喜欢它们的方式，就像我们喜欢漂亮的窗帘布料一样。

lines.en: I think that young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else.
lines.zh: 我认为小孩子往往比任何人都更能欣赏现代画。

lines.en: but she always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.
lines.zh: 但她总是告诉我我的画好不好。

lines.en: She came into my room yesterday.
'I'm hanging this picture on the wall,' I answered. 'It's a new one. Do you like it?'
lines.zh: “我正在把这幅画挂在墙上，”我回答。“这是一幅新画。你喜欢吗？”

lines.en: She looked at it critically for a moment.
lines.zh: 她批判性地看了一会儿。

lines.en: 'It's all right,' she said, 'but isn't it upside down?'
lines.zh: “还行，”她说，“但这幅画是不是倒着挂的？”
